user.title: Pick the Versatile Thermostat to drive
user.description: One Hearth room per VTherm. Hearth writes only to the VTherm's preset temperature numbers and its preset, never raw setpoints.

data_description.vtherm_entity_id: The VTherm climate entity for this room. It must expose its own preset temperature numbers (untick 'use central configuration' for preset temperatures).
data_description.room_name: Optional. Defaults to the VTherm's name.

data.affected_presets: Presets the adaptive offset applies to

data_description.weather_entity_id: Optional. Leave empty to share another room's weather entity or the first one in Home Assistant.
data_description.outdoor_sensor_entity_id: Optional override. By default Hearth reads the VTherm's own outdoor temperature attribute.
data_description.base_comfort_temp: The comfort target when the running-mean outdoor temperature equals the reference (10 C).
data_description.band_min: Hard clamp. Hearth never writes a comfort target below this.
data_description.band_max: Hard clamp. Hearth never writes a preset temperature above this.
data_description.affected_presets: Comfort only is the v1 default.
data_description.base_boost_temp: Only used when boost is an affected preset.
data_description.solar_gain: Lowers the forecast-skip threshold on sunny days and trims the preheat target.
data_description.skip_decision_time: When the morning forecast-skip decision is taken.
data_description.skip_end_time: When an active skip ends and the schedule preset is restored.
data_description.bedtime_decision_time: When the cold-morning setback decision is taken.
data_description.workday_entity_id: Optional. A Workday integration sensor. On a Monday to Friday that is not a workday (bank holiday), the schedule uses its non_workday blocks, or Saturday's if it has none.
data_description.scheduler_entity_ids: Optional. Scheduler component schedules (switch.schedule_*) that define this room's weekly schedule. When set, Hearth derives the schedule from them and hearth.set_schedule is refused for this room. When the room's schedule switch is on, Hearth switches these schedules off itself and switches them back on when it stops driving the room.
data_description.warm_by_presets: Slots that set one of these presets become warm-by blocks (with preheat); the rest switch at their start time.
data_description.skippable_first_morning: The first warm-by block of each day before the morning cutoff (12:00) may be suppressed by the forecast skip.

error.band_inverted: The band minimum must not exceed the band maximum.
error.base_outside_band: The baseline comfort temperature must sit inside the band.

abort.already_configured: This VTherm already has a Hearth room.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Boost a room with Versatile Thermostat's timed preset, optionally at a chosen temperature, and tell Hearth who asked.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the boost lasts. Versatile Thermostat restores the previous preset afterwards.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Optional room temperature for the boost. Without it the room's boost preset temperature is used.

source.name: Source
source.description: Who asked: person, dashboard, valve or voice are a person's request and are learnt from; automation is not. Defaults to the caller.

override.name: Override
override.description: Stand Hearth down for a room so it heats normally for a while.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stand down. Defaults to the stand-down timeout.

recompute.name: Recompute
recompute.description: Force an adaptive recompute and write for one room or all rooms.

entry_id.name: Room
entry_id.description: The Hearth room (config entry). Leave empty for all rooms.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

force.name: Force write
force.description: Write the computed preset temperature even if it has not changed.

entry_id.name: Room
entry_id.description: Limit to one room's weather entity. Leave empty for all.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace a room's warm-by schedule. Refused for a room that takes its schedule from Scheduler entities.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Weekday to block list, e.g. mon: [{warm_by: '06:30', preset: comfort, skippable: true}, {at: '22:30', preset: eco}].

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Clear the override ledger for a room, or one attribution bucket, or the learned warming rate. What is cleared is kept so undo_reset can bring it back.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.description: Leave empty to reset every ledger bucket. warming_rate clears the learned warming rate instead (use it after changing the room's temperature sensor); it is never included in an empty reset.

export_learning.name: Export learning
export_learning.description: Return a room's learnt values (the warming rate, the override ledger and the outdoor running mean) as response data, to keep as a backup or to move to another room. Nothing is written to disk. Name one room to get its data directly; name none to get every room under 'rooms'.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

parts.name: Parts
parts.description: Which parts to export: warming_rate, ledger, running_mean. Leave empty for all three. A part with nothing learnt yet is left out.

import_learning.name: Import learning
import_learning.description: Replace a room's learnt values with data from export_learning, or built from the matching parts of a diagnostics download (room.mechanisms.warming, room.ledger and room.running_mean) placed under 'parts' as warming_rate, ledger and running_mean. Everything is checked before anything is applied, and each imported part replaces the room's current one. Importing a warming rate also drops any heating run in progress.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

data.name: Data
data.description: The learning data object, as returned by export_learning (format hearth.learning, version 1).

parts.name: Parts
parts.description: Which parts of the data to import: warming_rate, ledger, running_mean. Leave empty for every part the data holds.

undo_reset.name: Undo reset
undo_reset.description: Put back what the last reset_learning cleared in this room. Only the most recent reset is kept, and it is gone once undone. Learning recorded since the reset is kept alongside the restored values.

vtherm_entity_id.name: VTherm
vtherm_entity_id.description: Alternatively, the VTherm climate entity the room drives.

no_preset_entities.title: VTherm has no preset temperature numbers
no_preset_entities.description: Hearth room {room} cannot control {vtherm}: it has no per-room preset temperature number entities (for example number.living_room_preset_comfort_temp), so Hearth is leaving the room alone. In the VTherm's configuration, untick 'use central configuration' for preset temperatures. VTherm then creates the numbers at 7 C, so set them to the room's real preset temperatures before Hearth takes over. Until then you can keep the room on Observe only, which needs no numbers.

scheduler_day_conflict.title: Two Scheduler schedules claim the same day
scheduler_day_conflict.description: Hearth room {room} takes its schedule from Scheduler schedules, but more than one of them covers the same day ({detail}): {entities}. Hearth is not applying the change. Make each weekday belong to exactly one schedule, or remove one from the room's Scheduler schedules option.

scheduler_shared_source.title: A Scheduler schedule also drives rooms not on Hearth
scheduler_shared_source.description: Hearth room {room} will not take over {entities} because it also controls other climate entities that are not Hearth rooms with their schedule switch on ({detail}). Hearth has not switched it off and is not applying it. Split the schedule in the Scheduler card so each schedule only targets Hearth rooms, or turn on the schedule switch for those rooms.

scheduler_unsupported_action.title: A Scheduler slot is not a preset change
scheduler_unsupported_action.description: Hearth room {room} cannot follow {entities}: {detail}. Hearth only follows slots that use the climate.set_preset_mode action with frost, eco, comfort or boost. Hearth is not applying the change.

scheduler_source_enabled.title: A Scheduler schedule is still on
scheduler_source_enabled.description: Hearth took over room {room} but {entities} is still on, so Scheduler and Hearth may both be changing presets. Turn it off, or turn off the room's Hearth schedule switch to hand the room back to Scheduler.
